high_level_description: This image captures a joyous moment at what appears to be a traditional Indian wedding ceremony. The setting is outdoors, with a festive atmosphere created by hanging floral decorations in the background, predominantly featuring white and pink flowers. In the foreground, a man and a woman are the central figures. The man, on the left, is shirtless and wearing a white dhoti with a gold border. He has a beard and is adorned with a garland of red and yellow flowers around his neck. His expression is one of happiness as he looks towards the woman.
